title: Rose and Spectral Deer
description: A massive vibrant red rose with dark green leaves dominates the left foreground in a misty grassy field. To the right stands a glowing blue-white magical deer with antlers, set against a twilight sky featuring a large red sun on the left and a crescent moon on the upper right.
prompt: A giant, highly detailed red rose with lush dark green leaves stands tall in the left foreground of a misty grassy field at twilight. To the right, a luminous blue and white spectral deer with antlers stands glowing in the grass. Dramatic sky with a large red sun setting on the left and a crescent moon in the dark blue sky above, atmospheric mist, fantasy style, cinematic lighting.
